instructions: How to use this file: The essential elements are all 'id', 'type', 'form', 'order', and 'translation' items and the paths leading to them, as well as the root elements 'creator' (must be left as is), 'key', 'display', and 'rtl'. All other items, including this text, are non-essential and will not be regarded during an import operation. Furthermore, subsets of this file can be created and used at will, as long as it remains valid JSON. The 'hash' items are not essential, but assist in tracking if a default value has changed since the file was created, and thus a translation may be out of date. During an import operation, a best-effort approach is taken. Any paths and/or ids that do not match the target will be silently ignored. Thus, a cross-project import of field translations would only work for fields of the same name.

label.translation: ¿Ha estado comenzando muchos más proyectos o esta haciendo más cosas arriesgadas que antes?

label.translation: ¿Se siente nervioso, ansioso, con miedo, preocupado, o tenso?

label.translation: ¿Se siente con pánico o asustado?

label.translation: ¿Ha estado evitando situaciones que le dan ansiedad?

label.default: Unexplained aches and pains (e.g., head, back, joints, abdomen, legs)?
label.translation: ¿Tiene molestias o dolores fuertes en el cuerpo que no tienen explicaciones?

label.default: Feeling that your illnesses are not being taken seriously enough?
label.translation: ¿Se siente que sus enfermedades no están siendo tomados en serio?

label.default: Thoughts of actually hurting yourself?
label.translation: ¿Tiene pensamientos reales de hacerse daño a si mismo?

label.default: Hearing things other people couldn't hear, such as voices even when no one was around?
label.translation: ¿Ha escuchado cosas que otros no pueden oír, como voces, aunque no haiga alguien cerca?

label.default: Feeling that someone could hear your thoughts, or that you could hear what another person was thinking?
label.translation: ¿Se siente que otros le pueden oír sus pensamientos, o que usted puede oír lo que los demás están pensando?

label.default: Problems with sleep that affected your sleep quality over all?
label.translation: ¿Tiene problemas con su ciclo de sueño que le afectan su habiilidad de dormir bien?

label.default: Problems with memory (e.g., learning new information) or with location (e.g., finding your way home)?
label.translation: ¿Tiene problemas de memoria (e.g., aprendiendo información nueva) o con su ubicación (e.g., buscando como llegar a casa)?

label.default: Unpleasant thoughts, urges, or images that repeatedly enter your mind?
label.translation: ¿Tiene pensamientos, deseos, o imágenes que entran a su mente que son desagradables?

label.default: Feeling driven to perform certain behaviors or mental acts over and over again?
label.translation: ¿Se siente impulsado a llevar a cabo ciertos comportamientos o actos mentales una y otra vez?

label.default: Feeling detached or distant from yourself, your body, your physical surroundings, or your memories?
label.translation: ¿Se siente desconectado o más distante de si mismo, de su cuerpo, su alrededores, o sus memorias?

label.default: Not knowing who you really are or what you want out of life?
label.translation: ¿Se siente que no sabe quién es usted realmente o qué quiere de la vida?

label.default: Not feeling close to other people or enjoying your relationships with them?
label.translation: ¿Se siente que no tiene relaciones intimas con nadie o que no disfruta sus relaciones con los demás?

label.default: Drinking at least 4 drinks of any kind of alcohol in a single day?
label.translation: ¿Esta tomando más de 4 bebidas alcohólicas al día?

label.default: Smoking any cigarettes, a cigar, or pipe, or using snuff or chewing tobacco?
label.translation: ¿Fuma cigarros, puros, pipas, o mastica tabaco?

label.default: Using any of the following medicines ON YOUR OWN, that is, without a doctor's prescription, in greater amounts or longer than prescribed [e.g., painkillers (like Vicodin), stimulants (like Ritalin or Adderall), sedatives or tranquilizers (like sleeping pills or Valium), or drugs like marijuana, cocaine or crack, club drugs (like ecstasy), hallucinogens (like LSD), heroin, inhalants or solvents (like glue), or methamphetamine (like speed)]?
label.translation: ¿Esta usando las medicinas siguientes, por su propia cuenta sin una receta, o en mayor cantidades: pastillas para el dolor (Vicodin), estimulantes (Ritalin o Adderall), sedantes o tranquilizantes ( pastillas para dormir o Valium), o marihuana, cocaína, éxtasis, droga alucinógenos, heroína, inhalantes, o metanfetamina?

header.default:
DSM-5 Adult (ASRM)

Choose the one statement in each group that best describes the way you (the individual receiving care) have been feeling for the past week.

Please note:
The word "occasionally" when used here means once or twice; "often" means several times or more and "frequently" means most of the time.
header.translation:
DSM-5 Adult (ASRM)

Elija la afirmación de cada grupo que mejor describa cómo se ha sentido usted (la persona que recibe atención) durante la semana pasada.

Tenga en cuenta:
The word "occasionally" when used here means once or twice; "often" means several times or more and "frequently" means most of the time.

label.translation: Pregunta 1

enum.translation: No me siento más feliz ni más alegre que de costumbre.

enum.default: I feel happier or more cheerful than usual all of the time.
enum.translation: Me siento más feliz o más alegre que de costumbre todo el tiempo.

header.default:
During the past TWO (2) WEEKS, how much (or how often) have you been bothered by the following problems?

0=None (Not at all), 1=Slight (Rare, less than a day or two), 2=Mild (Several days), 3=Moderate (More than half the days), 4=Severe (Nearly every day)

Durante las últimas DOS (2) SEMANAS, ¿cuánto y que seguido le han molestado los siguientes problemas?

0=Nada (Nunca), 1=Un Poco (menos de uno o dos días), 2=Levemente (Varios días), 3=Moderadamente (Más de la mitad de los días), 4=Severo (Todos los días)

The following questions ask about thoughts, feelings, and behaviors that you may have had about social situations. Usual social situations include: public speaking, speaking in meetings, attending social events or parties, introducing yourself to others, having conversations, giving and receiving compliments, making requests of others, and eating and writing in public.
